item.title: Anne Arundel County Tax Guide
item.description:
Anne Arundel County Tax Guide

Understanding taxes in Anne Arundel County is essential for budgeting and financial planning. This guide covers property taxes, income taxes, sales taxes, and other tax obligations.

Property Taxes

Anne Arundel County Property Tax

County Tax Rate:

  • Based on assessed value of property
  • Rates change annually
  • Published each fiscal year
  • Different rates for residential and commercial

Assessment Process:

  • Property assessed annually
  • Assessment based on market value
  • Assessment notices sent annually
  • Appeal process available

Anne Arundel County Utility Costs

Understanding utility costs in Anne Arundel County is essential for budgeting. This guide covers electric, water, gas, internet, and other utility expenses throughout the county.

Electric Service

AEP Maryland

Service Area:

  • Most of Anne Arundel County
  • Primary electric provider
  • Generation and distribution

Contact:

  • Phone: 410-486-1234
  • Website: www.aepmaryland.com
  • Outages: 410-486-1234

Electric Rates

Rate Structure:

  • Base rate per kilowatt-hour
  • Seasonal variations
  • Time-of-use pricing available
  • Different tiers based on usage

item.title: Anne Arundel County Housing Calculator
item.description:
Anne Arundel County Housing Calculator

Understanding housing costs in Anne Arundel County is crucial for budgeting. This guide helps you estimate mortgage payments, rent, and total housing affordability.

Housing Market Overview

Anne Arundel County Housing

Market Type:

  • Competitive suburban market
  • Near Baltimore and DC
  • Strong demand
  • Prices higher than national average

Price Ranges:

Condos/Apartments:

  • 1 bedroom: $180,000-300,000
  • 2 bedroom: $250,000-400,000
  • 3 bedroom: $350,000-500,000+

Single Family Homes:

  • 2-3 bedroom: $350,000-550,000
  • 4 bedroom: $500,000-800,000+
  • Luxury/waterfront: $800,000-2,000,000+
